notes.title: 🎉 Big News! Earl's MineCart Adventures is Now Free to Play! 🎉
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Earl's MineCart Adventures is now available to play for free on Steam! Dive into the thrilling world of underground mining and embark on a wild ride through challenging tunnels and caverns.

🚂 Get Ready for Action: Take control of your very own minecart and navigate through treacherous paths filled with obstacles, surprises, and hidden treasures!

💰 Discover Hidden Gems: Explore the depths of the mines and uncover valuable gems and artifacts to earn rewards and upgrades for your minecart.

🆓 No Cost to Play: Enjoy the excitement of Earl's MineCart Adventures without spending a dime. It's free to play for everyone on Steam!

Don't miss out on this thrilling adventure! Gather your friends, hop into your minecart, and start exploring the depths of Earl's MineCart Adventures today! Download now on Steam and let the mining madness begin! 🛤️💎

Enjoy the game!

[b]TreeNutsGames[/b]

notes.title: Earl's Minecart Adventures to be FREE TO PLAY!
notes.content:
[h3]We would like to announce that Earl's Minecart will be free to play![/h3]

To us it is valuable that as many people as possible have fun playing the game! 
We love this game and that has to be shared to everyone!

Looking at our current statistics, players and sales. Charging for the game is simply not worth is to us. For that same reason, the game will be set to be free to play as soon as possible. 

Nothing changes for the people already friends with Earl, but for new players they can start their Earl's Minecart Adventure for free!

Enjoy and cheers!
